title: Agent Role Documentation Authority Rewrite Checklist

items.label: Capture the Project Control cleanup path and role catalog target before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, and Evidence target are identified before editing the role catalog.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup, owner repo-project-control, active role project-control-steward, phase target phase-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-agent-role-rewrite, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-agent-role-rewrite, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-agent-role-documentation-authority-rewrite-2026-09-01.

items.label: Write a failing role catalog guard for documentation authority drift.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Project Control documentation authority test fails before the role catalog contains the new authority rules.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included npx vitest run tests/documentation-authority-policy.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failing because docs/domains/flowdoc-role-catalog.md did not yet contain Documentation Authority For Roles.

items.label: Update the role catalog with documentation authority responsibilities and stop rules.
items.evidenceTarget: The role catalog names how Project Control Steward, Documentation Synthesizer, Product Implementation Agent, Planning Partner, Evidence Reviewer, Cross-Repo Boundary Reviewer, and Lane Reconciliation Reviewer prevent documentation authority drift.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-role-catalog.md now contains Documentation Authority For Roles, blocks Product Implementation Agent from creating product-repository docs/superpowers plans or specs for FlowDoc-wide truth, and requires broad plans to start in Project Control Work, Phase, Checklist, and Evidence targets.

items.label: Verify the Project Control role guard and generated read model.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused role guard, npm run generate, and Project Control validation pass after the role catalog update.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence after the role catalog update passed npx vitest run tests/documentation-authority-policy.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 with 1 file and 6 tests, npm run generate, and npm run check:data.

items.label: Record the role rewrite evidence without promoting product truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control evidence cites the role rewrite commit, files, verification, and boundaries intentionally not promoted.
items.verificationNote: Evidence is work-scoped with nodeIds [] and keeps Core, Backend, Editor, compatibility, frontend readiness, FlowDoc product truth, and map truth unpromoted.
